name: list_vercel_ci_task_definitions
description:
List the task definitions of a Vercel CI job run attempt.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/vercel-ci/invocations/{invocationId}/attempts/{attempt}/job-definitions/{jobDefinitionId}/runs/{runAttempt}/task-definitions --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.
